messages:
maria: Heads-up — Velos (P1 pilot) just asked to pin sensorX-v2.1 in APAC + EU. They want dedicated/reserved capacity with p99 < 120ms and an enterprise SLA. Can we triage feasibility and launch acceptance criteria?

sam: Do we have a quantized build for v2.1? fallback to smaller hosted model should be defined. Also need qps numbers.

sales-ryan: @maria they're projecting steady 30 qps and spikes up to ~120 qps during peak telemetry windows. They're willing to pay for reserved capacity.

support-jess: Logged a ticket — they saw timeouts when routed to eu-west last week, might be related. Ticket #SUP-9123.

vikram: Need model size + quantization target. Float16 vs 4-bit changes infra sizing a lot. Which did customer request?

maria: They asked for float16 initially but said open to 4-bit if accuracy holds. Product asks: perf within SLA, accuracy within ±2% of their baseline, infra cost estimate, and a fallback strategy.

elaine: We don't have sensorX v2.1 in catalog yet — only v2.0. I need model artifact, tokenizer, SHA, and license info from the customer to start ingestion.

sales-ryan: Sharing artifact link and sample prompts: https://git.example.com/velos/sensorX/releases/tag/v2.1 (customer gave this).

maria: Draft launch checklist (quick):
1) confirm artifacts + license
2) infra sizing & perf test
3) QA eval on sample prompts (accuracy thresholds)
4) SLA & price proposal from sales
5) canary schedule in APAC -> EU cutover
6) fallback routing to hosted-small variant
7) legal & DPA signoff

vikram: Quick infra note: float16 likely requires 2x A100-80GB per shard for target qps; 4-bit quant could fit on a single H100-80GB with optimized kernels. I'll run perf tests tomorrow (ETA ~24h).

elaine: I'll start a catalog entry draft and mark it 'experimental-pin' until QA finishes. Need the SHA from repo to lock the entry.

support-jess: Also flagging data residency — customer will process EU+APAC telemetry. Can legal confirm DPA requirements?

legal-kate: Yes — APAC data processing will need a DPA addendum. I'll send our template to sales.

maria: Next steps: sales confirm commit length & budget, infra runs perf tests, product signs off launch criteria, legal sends DPA. I'll convert this into a backlog item with P1 priority.

sales-ryan: Customer confirmed a 6-month reserved commitment contingent on SLA and price.

vikram: Perf tests done: 4-bit quant build results -> p95: 45ms, p99: 110ms, sustained qps 100. Accuracy delta ~1.8%. Snippet: ```perf: p95:45ms p99:110ms qps:100 accuracy_delta:1.8%```

elaine: QA ran 2k sample prompts — accuracy delta 1.6%, edge-case failures minimal. Marking as pass for our acceptance threshold.

maria: Product accepts pin if infra cost estimate stays within the proposed budget (sales to confirm $/token) and DPA signed. Can someone open a catalog PR to pin v2.1 and add geo tags for apac+eu?

elaine: Opening PR now -> https://git.internal/redwood/catalog/pulls/4823 (includes metadata, sha, license).

infra-bot: Deploy plan created: canary apac-prod 10% traffic -> 100% over 6h. Rollback webhook configured.

maria: Great work team. I'll update Velos and close the intake once legal confirms DPA signed and sales confirms price. :tada:
